description: List leads for the current tenant. Filters: search (title/email/phone/best_phone — a search term that looks like a NUMBER is additionally matched against the last nine digits of phone, best_phone and fax, so '017612345678' finds a lead stored as '0176 12345678'. To identify a CALLER use find_by_phone instead: it also covers contacts, accounts and the call history, and states how sure it is), category (exact, case-insensitive), status, campaign_id, no_campaign (true = only leads in no campaign), owner_id, min_score (0-100), stale_days (last activity older than N days). order_by: score|last_activity|created (default score). Returns category + score + last_activity_at. Unless include_memory=false, each lead also carries memory[] (its AI-memory items — any note attached to the lead, newest first, each trimmed to ~memory_tokens total per lead) and memory_truncated (true if some notes/text were omitted for size). For a COMPLETE, untruncated pull of every lead's full fields + all memory + nested contact/account, use export_leads instead.

custom.description: Filter on lead custom fields (list_custom_fields entity 'leads'): { key: value } — value = equals (multiselect: contains), array = any of (multiselect: contains all), null = empty. E.g. { "stufe": "A", "marken": ["KTM"] }.

include_memory.description: Attach recent AI memory per lead (default true)

memory_tokens.description: Approx max tokens of memory per lead (default 200, max 1000); older entries cut off

min_score.description: Only leads with at least this score (0-100)

no_campaign.description: Only leads not assigned to any campaign

stale_days.description: Only leads whose last activity is older than N days

name: list_leads
